description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1582/08 of 29.12.2008
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically deals with the amendment of a land name ('Ambagaskotuwa Watta' to 'Ambagaspitiye Watta') in a land acquisition context under the Land Acquisition Act. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative matters, including reference to lot numbers, preliminary plans, and is issued by the Divisional Secretary in relation to land records. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
